Anyone on Google could assume this role.

  Anyone            exact             No grant is placed with people who have no account anywhere.
  Anyone on Google  unknown  grant 1  Anyone on Google could assume this role; which claims name an owner is not recorded.
  A named outsider  exact             No grant is placed with a named outsider.
  Your pipelines    exact             No grant is confined to owners declared as yours.
  Your people       exact             No grant trusts a SAML provider declared as yours.

Each of these can narrow the rings and was not read: the organisation's resource control policies, the calling accounts' service control policies and this account's identity providers.

grant 1 of 1 · statement[0] "GoogleAudience" · Allow · https://accounts.google.com · platform · unknown
This role admits every identity accounts.google.com issues a token to, whoever holds it: the only claim named is aud, and an audience is not a boundary.
Exact means the set is known exactly, not that it is small: no construct went unevaluated.

a token this grant admits
  {
    "iss": "https://accounts.google.com",

The decoded payload. A claim not shown is unconstrained by this grant, but for azp, and none of the claims shown names an identity: whoever holds a token like this is admitted. It sets no azp: AWS reads aud from azp whenever a token sets one.
